# Tochigi Prefecture borehole log

Tochigi Prefecture, Department of Land Development (栃木県 県土整備部), publishes this borehole log under CC BY 2.1 Japan. This fixture is the unmodified file 11901049606.pdf from archive 1 of the prefecture’s boring-log dataset. [Dataset](https://data.bodik.jp/dataset/090000_boring-log) · [Source archive](https://data.bodik.jp/dataset/a6ee71a9-c0d4-4386-803d-e588fb0ed7ca/resource/4cc62581-9adf-4aaa-a970-79dd240494f4/download/72402_2014_boring-log1_04010.zip) · [License](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.1/jp/)

The second sheet prints three layer bases alongside thicknesses, elevations and Japanese soil names. It also contains SPT records in a separate column. The PDF’s SHA-256 is `366e287fff89bc06a0260252cfba611fa830bbc11143f7e8261f659bb9919364`.
